items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: My father played guitar some years ago, and also the bass pedal.

ctx.x: 27, 27. Well, the story goes like this.

My family, as my mother and father, were somewhat musically inclined. My father played guitar some years ago, and also the bass pedal. My mother used to play the piano. So much for that with Ogiee Socia, which I will just mention it, which my father played with, whose name is the same as mine. I'm a junior, otherwise I didn't mention that. In those days, I used to play with bass who sang quite often. And after the dance, it seems like my house has been, or our house, it wasn't mine at that time, it was there,…
In other words, when they knock off of the job, they come into your house and play until train time.
